headline: Private debt: "Scissors" on advance payments and strict rules for servicers - All the changes
summary: Greece's Ministry of National Economy and Finance is promoting stricter rules on private debt regulation, protection of compliant debtors and the operation of servicers, including changes to advance payments.
why: Rules governing debt servicers and collection affect the recovery values of non-performing loans and the economics of servicing companies and banks.
